messages:
Emma: Heads up — we need an expedited hotfix deploy for a tokenizer timeout affecting long prompts in eu-west1. Planning a surge window now+30m. Need fast approvals for canary lift and pinning.
release-bot: Deploy queued: release/1.2.10-hotfix -> canary 5% (eu-west1). Trigger: @Emma
ops-bot: Preflight checks: infra=OK, db-conns=OK, e2e-smoke=FAIL (tokenizer_integration_timeout)
Liam: Which test is failing? stack?
Raj: tokenizer_integration_timeout — intermittent on long prompt path. Seen in staging once in last 2 hours.
SRE Oncall: Oncall: p99 tokenization latency spiked in the warmup window. Canary at 5% is low risk. +1 for hotfix but recommend pin to quantized variant and explicit rollback conditions.
Emma: Proposal: release 1.2.10-quant (pin model variant) to eu-west1 only. Canary 8% -> ramp to 30% over 10m, hold for 30m. Rollback if error_rate > 3% OR p99 > 300ms OR kvcache_miss increase >1.5% sustained 5m.
Raj: :thumbsup: from releases. prefer manual hold at 30% for quick inspection.
Liam: Approving. I'll monitor logs and traces during the hold.
release-bot: Manual approval required to lift canary to 8% and start ramp. React with :white_check_mark: to approve immediate ramp.
Raj: :white_check_mark:
Liam: :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Applying pin: model=redwood/tok-quant-v2@1.2.10 -> eu-west1
release-bot: Deploy started: canary 8% -> 30% over 10m. Tracking: https://internal.deploy/release/2048123456
SRE Oncall: Watchlist: p99_tokenize, overall_error_rate, kvcache_miss. I've set alerts for error_rate > 2% and p99 > 250ms for rapid triage.
release-bot: Canary progress: 8% -> 15%. Metrics: error_rate=0.1%, p99=120ms, kvcache_miss=0.6%.
Emma: Good. Continue ramp to 30%.
release-bot: Canary progress: 30% reached. Holding for 30 minutes per plan.
Liam: Observing kvcache_miss rising: baseline 0.5% -> now 1.9% at 30% traffic. Latency p99 still ~130ms. Logs show a few KV retry spikes.
SRE Oncall: If kvcache_miss > 1.5% for 5m continuously, we rollback. Watching now.
Emma: Consensus check — proceed to steady rollout if metrics stabilize. Raj? Liam? SRE?
Raj: :thumbsup:
Liam: :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: +1 monitoring. No rollback yet, will call if threshold breached.
release-bot: Canary hold complete. No automated rollback triggered. Proceeding to finalize rollout to steady-state (regional pin remains).
release-bot: Release notes generated: "1.2.10 — hotfix: fixes tokenizer timeout on long prompts. Pinned quantized model variant in eu-west1 for stability. Rollback criteria: error_rate>3% | p99>300ms | kvcache_miss>1.5% sustained 5m."
Emma: Change window closed. Filing post-deploy pulse and follow-up runbook items (KV cache tuning). Thanks team for fast approvals. :tada:
SRE Oncall: Marking incident checks as normal. Will keep an eye for next 2h.
Liam: Logging follow-up perf traces into the release ticket.
